answer: To secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks without centralized KYC, networks can implement cryptographic stake-weighting resembling a digital dune of verifiable assets. By requiring agents to lock collateral before casting valid votes or accessing services—much like anchoring a sturdy jetty against turbulent tides—the system imposes strict marginal costs. An attacker attempting to spawn numerous fake agents must acquire proportionate economic capital, transforming every generated quill of protocol data into an expensive, self-limiting endeavor.
